profile.headline: SWE @ Bloomberg
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I love helping people, designing, and learning.

As a software engineer, I would like to support and contribute towards goals that promote human connections.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Made contributions to terminal mnemonic DOCV, used by ASKB agent.
• Worked on full-stack features, designed architecture using Bloomberg's tools.
• Contributed to stability solutions for our applications, and CI/CD solutions.
• Delivered and successfully released last minute features requested by product team.
• Mentored new members of the team on our technologies and team practices.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · SQL · Redis · Groovy · Vue.js · Jenkins · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Communicated with stakeholders to gather requirements of the project.
• Collaborated with another intern to design the frontend and backend integration.
• Worked on a solution that will save 100 days of engineering time per quarter.
• Built a REST API using the Flask framework to assist internal members with their daily tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Flask · Nomad · SQL · Docker

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Instructional Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted the instructor of a computer architecture class of over 50 students.
• Communicated with the instructional team weekly regarding students’ success.
• Helped students with technical problems (Linux), debugging (C, Logisim), and subject concepts.
• Provided input on students’ assignments and grading criteria for evaluation.

positions.title: History Department Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assist students with holds, overrides, and other course related processes.
•	Process book orders and obtain books from publishers.
•	Guide and assist students with their questions, concerns, and issues.

positions.title: Web Developer Tester Intern
positions.description:
• Corroborated correct functionality of large-scale web and mobile applications used by approximately 23,000 students.
• Verified websites were up to the proper accessibility standards by using SAC and NVDA software.
• Ensured SQL and HTML injections were unsuccessful by using Telerik Fiddler software.
• Reported potential issues and errors in functionality by using JIRA software.
• Identified and applied test cases for a wide range of products.
• Responsible for testing large-scale web and mobile applications.
• Identifying test cases and testing of products.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · SQL

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Financial Aid Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assisted students in the registration and application process.
•	Guided parents and students into the right departments and resources.
•	Informed and helped to clarify doubts, concerns, and issues.
•	Ensured that the data entered by the student was accurate and relevant.

positions.title: Food Server
positions.description:
•	Deliver quality service by providing a warm and welcoming environment.
•	Serving customer’s orders.
•	Ensured a clean and healthy environment. 
•	Assist in preparing the counter recipes such as dressings, gelatin desserts, puddings, and salads.
